procedural_matters: NED 213481 was represented by Audrius Moliakov.
Dewi Couvert (coach of NED 213481) attended the hearing as an observer.
CRO 211911 did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
The protest time limit was 15:37. The hearing was initially scheduled for 15:45. The hearing eventually started at 16:07.

Lovre Bakotic (CRO 211911) arrived at the hearing at 16:20 after the panel finished taking evidence. The panel decided that CRO 211911 was not unavoidably absent, and therfore there is no a good reason to restart the hearing.
CRO 211911 was represented by Lovre Bakotic when the protest committee gave the decision.
facts: The incident occurred in race 9, shortly after the starting signal.
The windspeed was 13-16 knots with 1-metre waves.
NED 213481 was sailing on starboard, CRO 211911 on port, on a collision course with NED
CRO 211911 bore away, and a contact occurred between the bow of CRO 211911 and the port- side rear corner of NED 213481.
The contact resulted in damage: the gelcoat came off on NED 213481, and as a result, the boat started leaking.
Both boats started in the restart of race 9 and sailed the course.
After another 1.5 hrs of sailing, it took 2 minutes for NED 213481 to empty the boat.
conclusions: CRO 211911 on port tack failed to keep clear of NED 213481 on starboard tack, and broke RRS 10.
CRO 211911 did not avoid contact with NED 213481 even though it was reasonably possible, and broke RRS 14(a).
It was not reasonably possible for NED 213481 the right-of-way boat to avoid contact with CRO 211911 when it became clear that CRO 211911 was not keeping clear. NED 213481 did not break RRS 14(a).
The jury considers the damage as serious damage.
Since the incident caused serious damage, CRO 211911 may be penalized as per RRS 36(b), even though the race was restarted.
